prompt.en: Since when has Canada been a constitutional monarchy in its own right?
prompt.fr: Depuis quand le Canada est-il une monarchie constitutionnelle à part entière?

explanation.en: Canada became a constitutional monarchy of its own at Confederation, in 1867. Queen Victoria was on the throne in that year.
explanation.fr: Le Canada est devenu une monarchie constitutionnelle qui lui est propre lors de la Confédération, en 1867. La reine Victoria régnait cette année-là.

source.quote: Canada has been a constitutional monarchy in its own right since Confederation in 1867 during Queen Victoria’s reign.

verification.evidence: Canada has been a constitutional monarchy in its own right since Confederation in 1867 during Queen Victoria’s reign.
